I don't think this level can be won, so I can't give a winning sequence.

**Why it looks impossible:**

- The door at (14,12) is on a small island to the west. The trader is on the east island, and the water between them is 6 cells wide in row 12 (x=17 to 22). Rows 11 and 13 are blocked at x=16 by walls, and every other route through the water is longer.
- Every column from 17 to 22 has to be made walkable, so at least 6 water cells must be sunk. Each sunk cell needs its own crystal, and there are only 4 crystals (#3 to #6).
- The magic mirror cannot help. From its west and south faces it only reflects things onto land cells at (24,14), (23,14), (25,15) and (25,16), or onto water cells that are reachable only from water cells in column 25. Those water cells would have to be sunk first, which uses up crystals. The only way to reach the west island by reflection is a jump of 11 cells south of the mirror, which is off the grid.
- The trader can't push a line of things, so it can't sink more than one crystal per cell.

The best progress I can make is to sink crystal #5 into the row-12 water: U, then L four times. That leaves the trader at (23,12), with 5 water cells still to fill and only 3 crystals left, so it still cannot reach the door.

The checker's result matches my analysis: all five moves were legal, and the level is still not won. I don't think any sequence can win it.

The trader has to reach the door at (14,12), and the only land route crosses six water cells in row 12 (x=17 to 22). Each sunk cell needs its own crystal, and there are only four crystals. The magic mirror can't create new sinks or reach the western island. So I'm not going to spend the remaining answers on guesses.

If the level has a solution I'm missing, it would need a mechanic that adds crystals, copies the trader, or lets it cross the water in a way the rules don't describe. Those would need to be checked against the level data, not guessed.

If the level data has an extra crystal or a narrower water gap than the diagram shows, the answer changes. Checking the level file would settle that faster than another guess.
